title: Balanced Greek Lentil Bowl
subtitle: with Roast Eggplant and Grains
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

ingredients.name: Brown and Black Rice with Quinoa

steps.text: Cook rice blend: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice blend and cook for 22-24 mins until tender. Drain.

Prep ingredients: While the rice blend is cooking, cut the eggplant widthwise into 1cm-thick slices. Cut the tomatoes into 1cm-thick slices. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the lentils.

Roast veggies: Put the eggplant and tomato on the lined tray, sprinkle with half the kofta seasoning and drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Bake for 20 mins or until tender (see Kitchen 101).

Cook lentils: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the garlic and parsley stems, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Stir in the lentils, tomato paste, remaining kofta seasoning, 2 tsp sugar and 180ml (¾ cup) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 5 mins or until thickened.

Serve up: Add the eggplant and tomato to the lentil mixture and stir to combine. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the rice blend and lentil mixture among bowls. Scatter over the parsley leaves and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: The eggplant flesh should start to break down during roasting so it's soft and creamy once cooked. If it's still a bit firm, drizzle with a little more oil and bake for a further 5 mins.
